visuals.title: How to Choose a Welder - Complete Comparison Chart
visuals.description: A comprehensive selection chart comparing four welding processes (Flux-Cored/FCAW, MIG/GMAW, Stick/SMAW, and TIG/GTAW) across six criteria: skill level, gas requirements, material types, material thickness ranges, typical applications, and weld cleanliness. Includes a sidebar with voltage identification and MIG/flux-cored selection guide. Also features a duty cycle example diagram showing 165A at 30% duty cycle.

visuals.title: Duty Cycle Example
visuals.description: A circular clock-like diagram illustrating duty cycle concept, showing 165A at 30% duty cycle with segments indicating 3 minutes welding and 7 minutes cooling periods within a 10-minute cycle.

visuals.title: Weld Cleanliness Comparison
visuals.description: A photograph showing four welding beads side by side, demonstrating different levels of spatter and cleanliness from 'More Spatter' to 'Extremely Clean' corresponding to the four welding processes.

page_summaries.1: Full-page infographic chart titled "HOW TO CHOOSE A WELDER" showing a comparison matrix of four welding processes with skill levels, gas requirements, materials, thicknesses, applications, and weld quality characteristics.
